theorems.name: Submission.doraggt_ae_rescaled_lebesgue_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → ℝ), LocallyIntegrable g volume → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid n)), ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w in closedBall (0 : Euclid n) R, |g (v + r • w) - g v|) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
